goal: Identify net-new AI-first mobile/web app ideas for COLLEGE/UNIVERSITY students (student pays, B2C) that win a specific, recurring 'student moment' (e.g. the 11pm stuck-on-homework moment, exam-cram week, the dense-reading grind, the lecture-to-notes gap, group-project coordination, office-hours-unavailable). AI must be the CORE enabler - not a bolt-on. PRIMARY RANKING SIGNAL = NOVELTY / WHITE SPACE (uncontested space, no strong well-executed incumbent; exhaustive named-competitor check required incl. ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude free tiers, Quizlet, Chegg, Photomath/Gauth, Khanmigo, Question.AI, Studocu, Anki ecosystem, Grammarly, Notion AI, Turbolearn, Mindgrasp, plus funded startups and a live app-store scan). Userbase is NOT a differentiator (all ideas target the same large college market). HARD SCREENS (reject on failure): (1) CHATGPT-WRAPPER DEATH - if free ChatGPT/Gemini does it 80% as well in-chat, the idea dies; the wedge must be structurally outside chat. (2) ACADEMIC-INTEGRITY TRUST - no cheating-tool branding (school bans, app-store risk, platform ToS); the trust wedge must be 'makes you actually learn'. (3) BOUNDED COGS for long daily study sessions (students use tools for hours; unbounded LLM calls at 0/mo price points are fatal). (4) LEARNING WITHOUT DEPENDENCE - must improve recall/outcomes, not create answer-dependence; the cognitive-offloading literature is a kill-screen. Secondary: fast adoption, campus word-of-mouth virality, app-store discoverability, short path to first revenue, B2C subscription (-15/mo student price points) toward -5M+/yr.
feedback: Every hypothesis was rejected; the niche as specified is dead.
